QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR ANALYTICS
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Analytics cost in Limerick?

Retainers from €1,500 a month, or a one-off set-up. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Limerick?
Yes. We work with businesses in Limerick and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
Do you work with Universal Analytics or GA4?
GA4 only. Universal Analytics was sunset in 2023. If you're still on UA, migrating to GA4 is the first thing we'll do.
What is server-side tracking?

Server-side tracking sends conversion data directly from your server to advertising platforms (Meta CAPI, Google Ads enhanced conversions), bypassing ad blockers and iOS restrictions. It significantly improves attribution accuracy.
Can you integrate with our CRM?
Yes. We connect GA4 and GTM with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and other CRMs for full-funnel attribution.
